What it means: The Boston City Council Committee on Public Safety and Criminal Justice convened a hearing on Docket Number 0180 to discuss resources for the Boston Police Crime Lab [00:44, 01:43, 01:48, 01:51]. No representatives from the Boston Police Department or the administration attended the meeting [09:46, 10:12, 10:40]. Councilors expressed frustration over the absence, noting unresolved questions regarding leadership vacancies, staffing shortages, and delays in processing sexual assault evidence [03:16, 13:50, 14:27, 20:29].

Who moved it: The meeting was chaired by Councilor Henry Santana [00:41, 00:43]. The hearing order was sponsored by Councilor Flynn, Councilor Murphy, and Councilor Mejia [01:54, 01:56, 01:57]. Councilors Fitzgerald, Weber, and Worrell were also present and offered opening remarks [02:08, 02:11, 09:16].

What to watch: Chair Santana stated he will work with the sponsors and administration to try to find another date for the hearing [10:54, 10:56, 28:02, 28:05]. Councilor Flynn stated he intends to send letters requesting investigations by the state Forensic Science Oversight Board and the U.S. Attorney of Massachusetts [17:07, 17:11, 17:18, 27:08, 27:13]. No members of the public signed up to testify [28:01], and the passages do not settle when a rescheduled hearing will take place.

summary: On October 26, 2026, the Boston City Council Committee on Public Safety and Criminal Justice convened a hearing on Docket Number 0180 to discuss funding and resources for the Boston Police Crime Lab [00:48], [01:43]. Councilors addressed the lab's staffing shortages, prolonged leadership vacancies, and delays in processing sexual assault kits within the state-mandated 30-day window [03:16], [13:48], [24:20]. Because representatives from the Boston Police Department and the administration were absent [09:46], [10:39], no departmental testimony was taken. Councilor Flynn announced plans to request oversight and investigations from state forensic oversight officials and the U.S. Attorney [17:06], [27:06], and Chair Santana adjourned the meeting after agreeing to work on rescheduling the hearing for a later date [28:02], [28:18].
